scope.description: Hotfix every GitHub Actions job in PR #1: install CMake explicitly, give source-history tests a complete hosted checkout, separate repository-context tests from the production Docker build context, repair the archived-parent negative-test fixture, replace unavailable Ubuntu patch-version pins with a truthful base-digest-plus-resolved-package policy, record installed package manifests, and add dependency-lock regressions. Scientific kernels and release phase states are excluded.

assumptions: The six compiler/sanitizer matrix jobs share the same missing-CMake configure root cause observed in run 29674244956; the separate pinned-container job failed on retired apt patch versions.
The pinned Ubuntu base digest and HTSlib tarball SHA remain immutable authorities; mutable Ubuntu apt repositories cannot truthfully guarantee retired patch-version availability.
Resolved apt package versions must be captured inside the built image and the resulting production image must be identified by immutable digest before release.

Tests that require Git history or .github control files remain mandatory in hosted CI but are not valid production-image build-context tests because .git and .github are intentionally excluded from that context.

step_verify.step: Install CMake explicitly in every hosted-runner matrix job and use the apt-owned absolute path required by the toolchain source of truth.
step_verify.verify: Workflow regression confirms cmake is installed, test -x /usr/bin/cmake succeeds before configure, /usr/bin/cmake reports its version, and all six compiler/sanitizer jobs pass Configure.

step_verify.step: Replace retired apt patch-version pins with a truthful resolved-at-image-build policy while retaining immutable base and HTSlib authorities.
step_verify.verify: Dependency-lock check rejects exact apt package pins, Docker build succeeds, and separate builder/runtime package=version manifests exist under /opt/longlineage/share/provenance/.

step_verify.step: Replay local release gates and GitHub Actions after the focused fix.
step_verify.verify: Dependency lock, Release CTest/check_all, pinned-container smoke and every PR #1 GitHub Actions check exit 0; remaining scientific release blockers stay unchanged.

deviations: The first repaired Docker build passed compilation and then exposed three previously unreachable repository-context test assumptions plus an incomplete archived-parent scratch fixture. The scope expanded only to those CI regressions; no scientific code or phase state changed.

The hotfix remains on the existing docs/method-performance-audit branch because that branch is PR #1's failing review head. This is a documented branch-naming exception for the minimal repair; new behavior work must return to fix/* or feat/*.
